steps.title: Prepare Acidic Solution (0.1 M HCl)
steps.instruction: Prepare a 0.1 M HCl solution for acidification.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 0.83 mL of concentrated hydrochloric acid (HCl 37%) in 1 L of distilled water.
Store in a labeled flask.

steps.title: Prepare Basic Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare either a NaOH or NH4OH basic solution.

substeps.instruction: For NaOH: Dissolve 40 g of sodium hydroxide (NaOH) in 1 L of distilled water and store in a base-resistant glass flask.
For NH4OH: Add 28 mL of concentrated ammonium hydroxide (NH4OH 25%) to 1 L of distilled water and store in a well-sealed container.

steps.title: Acidification and Initial Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract alkaloids into the aqueous phase using acid.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 1 g of the sample into a screw-cap glass centrifuge tube.
Add 10 mL of 0.1 M HCl solution and shake well.
Subject the mixture to an ultrasonic bath for 480 seconds.

steps.title: Clean-up Extraction
steps.instruction: Remove non-basic substances from the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 mL of organic solvent (Ethyl Acetate).
Shake well and allow the phases to separate.
Centrifuge the mixture at 4500 rpm for 15 minutes.
Collect and discard the organic phase (upper phase); retain the aqueous phase containing the alkaloid salts.

steps.title: Basification
steps.instruction: Convert alkaloid salts to neutral form by adjusting pH.

substeps.instruction: Slowly add the basic solution (1 M NaOH or NH4OH) to the aqueous phase while monitoring pH with indicator paper or a pH meter.
Alternatively, add concentrated NH4OH drop-by-drop while shaking and monitoring pH.
Adjust the pH to 9-11 and shake well.

steps.title: Secondary Extraction of Alkaloids
steps.instruction: Extract neutral alkaloids into the organic phase.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 mL of organic solvent (Ethyl Acetate).
Shake well and allow the phases to separate.
Centrifuge the mixture at 4500 rpm for 15 minutes.
Collect and retain the organic phase containing the neutral alkaloids; discard the aqueous phase.
Repeat this organic extraction process 2-3 times to maximize recovery.

steps.title: Solvent Removal
steps.instruction: Concentrate the extracted alkaloids by removing the solvent.

substeps.instruction: Combine all organic phase fractions into a single flask.
Remove the solvent using a rotary evaporator or under a flow of air (preferably Nitrogen).
